title: BMAM: Brain-inspired Multi-Agent Memory Framework
abstract: arXiv:2601.20465v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language-model-based agents operating over extended interaction horizons face persistent challenges in preserving temporally grounded information and maintaining behavioral consistency across sessions, a failure mode we term soul erosion. We present BMAM (Brain-inspired Multi-Agent Memory), a general-purpose memory architecture that models agent memory as a set of functionally specialized subsystems rather than a single unstructured store. Inspired by cognitive memory systems, BMAM decomposes memory into episodic, semantic, salience-aware, and control-oriented components that operate at complementary time scales, organised as a six-phase memory lifecycle. To support long-horizon reasoning, BMAM organises episodic memories along explicit timelines and retrieves evidence by fusing multiple complementary signals. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that BMAM achieves 78.45% accuracy, outperforming seven memory-augmented baselines.

translated_title: BMAM：类脑多智能体记忆框架
translated_abstract: 基于语言模型的智能体在长时程交互场景下，面临着保持时间锚定信息和维持跨会话行为一致性的持续挑战，我们将这种失效模式称为“灵魂侵蚀”。我们提出了BMAM（类脑多智能体记忆），这是一种通用记忆架构，它将智能体记忆建模为一组功能特化的子系统，而非单一的非结构化存储。受认知记忆系统的启发，BMAM将记忆分解为情景记忆、语义记忆、显著性感知和控制导向等组件，这些组件在互补的时间尺度上运行，并被组织为一个六阶段的记忆生命周期。为支持长时程推理，BMAM沿显式时间线组织情景记忆，并通过融合多个互补信号来检索证据。在LoCoMo基准上的实验表明，BMAM达到了78.45%的准确率，优于七个记忆增强基线方法。
tldr: BMAM提出了一种受大脑启发的多智能体记忆框架，将记忆分解为情景、语义、显著性和控制导向等功能特化子系统并组织为六阶段记忆生命周期，在LoCoMo基准上以78.45%的准确率超越了七个记忆增强基线。
en_tdlr: BMAM introduces a brain-inspired multi-agent memory framework that decomposes memory into functionally specialized subsystems organized as a six-phase lifecycle, achieving 78.45% accuracy on the LoCoMo benchmark and outperforming seven memory-augmented baselines.
